observation: One square tile, one solid. Iso: a smooth circular central pad with a ring of small flat-topped boulders around it, inside the tile's own rounded square outline -- the belt tile the concept describes. Top: the rubble ring is complete and unbroken all the way round and the central pad is clear of it. Front: the boulders stand proud of a flat slab and nothing on the pad does, which is what a seated disc needs. No missing, extra or floating geometry, no visible intersection, proportions match 33.50 square by 6.00 tall.
